newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Four men found killed outside Colombian resort.
newsitem.headline: Four men found killed outside Colombian resort.

text.p: The bullet-riddled bodies of four men, all of them showing signs of having been tortured, were discovered outside Colombia's Caribbean resort city of Cartagena, police said on Tuesday.
They said none of the victims, whose scarred bodies were discovered late on Monday, had been identified and there were no immediate leads as to who their killers were.
A police spokesman said, however, that the crime had all of the hallmarks of a "settling of accounts" between criminal gangs operating in the Cartagena area.

The historic port city, Colombia's prime tourist resort, has been racked by a wave of unsolved killings targeting criminals and social "undesirables" since late last year. Police or right-wing death squads conducting a so-called campaign of "social cleansing" are leading suspects in some of the killings, according to local human rights groups.
